name: solitaire
title: Solitaire
description: Klondike on a felt table: drag the cards with the mouse, or play with the arrows and Enter. Draw one or three, unlimited passes and undo; the game and your record are kept.
author: pal

settings.label: Draw
settings.description: Cards turned from the stock at a time. Applies from the next deal.

settings.label: Clock
settings.text: Show the time while you play
settings.description: Off hides the running time beside the table. Your time still shows when you win. Also T or ⌘K in the game.

store.tagline: Klondike solitaire with the mouse or the keyboard
features: Drag cards and runs with the mouse; the piles they can go on light up
Keyboard play with the arrows and `enter`; `enter` twice sends a card where it belongs
Cards glide and flip, and a win bounces them off the foundations
Draw one or three, unlimited passes, and undo with `U` or `backspace`
Finishes by itself once every card is face up
Your moves, time and games won are kept, and the game waits where you left it
A daily deal, the same cards for everyone that day (`Y`); signed in to pal, your record follows you, and wins go on leaderboards: the day's fastest, and the fastest and fewest-move wins at each draw

screenshots.caption: A fresh deal: the cursor on the stock, the moves, the time and the record beside the table
54 moves in: the cursor takes 4 cards of a run, the title line names them
Enter picks the run up: it lifts, and the pile it can go on lights up
Won: every card home, the moves and the time, Enter deals again

actions.title: Pick up, drop
actions.description: Enter on a card picks it up (with the cards under it, as deep as ↑ reached); Enter on another pile drops them there. On the stock, draws. With the mouse: drag, or click the cards and then the pile.

actions.title: Send where it goes
actions.description: Enter again on the pile the cards came from, or a double-click: to the card's foundation, else to the first pile that takes them.

actions.title: Previous pile, next pile
actions.description: Across the stock, the waste, the foundations and the seven piles, wrapping round. `h` and `l` too.

actions.title: More cards, fewer cards
actions.description: How deep into a face-up run to take; past it, the row above or below. `k` and `j` too.

actions.title: Draw
actions.description: From anywhere; turns the waste back over when the stock is out.

actions.title: Undo
actions.description: The last move back, or the cards you hold put back.

actions.title: New game
actions.description: Asks first mid-game; the game counts as lost.

actions.title: Daily deal
actions.description: Today's deal, draw one, the same cards for everyone until midnight UTC; a win goes on the day's board. Asks first mid-game.

actions.title: Hide the clock
actions.description: No running time beside the table; again to bring it back.

solitaire.title: Solitaire
solitaire.description: The table. Escape leaves mid-game; it is there when you come back.

keys.title: Pick up, drop; twice on the same card, send it where it goes; draw on the stock
One more card of the run, then the row above (also down, k, j)
New game, after a confirm mid-game
The daily deal, after a confirm mid-game
